summary: Iteration 346 - Booking Conflicts Refactor Verification. All 15 tests PASSED (7 new + 1 race + 6 iter338 + 1 skipped). The refactor moved conflict-check logic from routes/resources/_common.py to services/booking_conflicts.py with thin shim re-exports for backward compatibility. Behavior is byte-identical to before.

check_conflicts_endpoint.description: POST /api/resources/{resource_id}/check-conflicts returns {conflicts: [...]} - empty for free slots, populated for overlapping slots

splitable_room_conflicts.description: No sub-rooms (children) exist in test data. 30 splittable parent rooms exist but no child resources with parent_resource_id set.

blackout_periods.description: Blackout periods correctly surface as conflicts with reason='blackout'. Tested via curl: created blackout, check-conflicts returned {reason: 'blackout', title, resource_id, start_at, end_at}

buffer_time.description: Booking within buffer window of existing booking is reported as conflict. Resource with buffer_time_min=15 correctly expands query window.

booking_crud.description: POST /api/resource-bookings succeeds for free slots, returns 409 for overlapping slots. PUT respects conflict checks when moving bookings.

allowed_combinations.description: No sub-rooms with allowed_combinations restrictions found in test data.

race_condition_winner.description: Race-condition winner selection (verify_booking_winner) works correctly. 10 concurrent requests: 1 success, 9 conflicts. 50 concurrent requests: 1 success, 49 conflicts.

iter338_backward_compat.description: All iter338 booking tests pass - allow_pending_overlap flag, check-conflicts returns status field, confirmed conflicts still block with flag.

shim_imports.description: Thin shim imports from _common.py work correctly: _check_conflicts, _verify_booking_winner, _validate_allowed_combination all resolve to the new service functions.

code_review.services/booking_conflicts.py: Clean extraction of conflict-check logic. Well-documented with docstrings explaining conflict rules (direct overlap, parent/child, buffer time, blackouts). verify_booking_winner has 50ms settle delay for read-visibility under concurrency.
code_review.routes/resources/_common.py: Lines 208-212 correctly re-export the underscore-prefixed names as thin shims for backward compatibility. No behavioral changes.
code_review.routes/resources/bookings.py: Unchanged imports from _common still work. Uses _check_conflicts, _verify_booking_winner, _validate_allowed_combination.
